changes.reason: ProjectGroupMoveInput now uses null as the explicit ungroup operation while continuing to reject the empty selection value.
Membership removal preserves Project evidence and continuation, keeps compare-and-swap conflict detection, and archives only a newly empty Series.
The Project settings UI separates the unselected placeholder from the explicit ungroup choice and warns before emptying a Series.
The warning presentation style does not change the chapter's grouping, evidence, or lifecycle semantics.
The generated TypeScript contract now exposes the nullable group target and requires current verified links.
The tracked OpenAPI schema changed with ProjectGroupMoveInput while preserving the documented generation boundary.
The tests fix ungroup and regroup behavior, conflict detection, empty-value rejection, Series archive, and continuation preservation.
The test fixes the current constraint that Project metadata membership changes share the Task runtime availability gate.
The source-contract tests fix explicit selection, null request mapping, disabled state, late-list stability, and the empty-Series warning.
The browser test proves that a grouped Project becomes ungrouped through the actual settings workflow.
The lifecycle policy now separates membership metadata from Project evidence, archive, purge, and continuation identity.
